title: 第七十四章 天罚催崩灵山境 佛心分裂起干戈第七十三章 如来强驯天盘遭反噬 灵山天降凶兆
content_zh:
灵山万顶，黑云锁穹。
自玉盘反噬天道、天降不祥凶兆以来，不过半日光阴，昔日万古祥和的佛域圣境，彻底沦为灾劫炼狱。
万里云海尽数暗沉，金光瑞霭寸寸消散，遍山金莲枯黑崩碎、随风零落。千年不灭的护法灵灯明暗颤摇，火光飘摇欲熄，山间禅木失尽灵气，枝干枯焦、簌簌落灰。大地佛纹隐隐开裂，道道细碎黑纹蔓延峰峦，如朽木崩腐、如业火噬根。
雷音宝殿之内，压抑死寂，杀机暗涌。
先前庆功大典的喧嚣欢歌荡然无存，满堂诸佛肃立两列，人人面色凝重、心神惶惶，眼底藏着惊惧、猜忌与悔意。九品莲台之上，如来金身端坐，表层佛光黯淡浮动，不复往日万丈煌威。
此前强行催动万佛本源驯化玉盘，遭苍生天道反噬，佛功紊乱、道基震荡、内腑受创，只是他强行镇压、秘而不宣。可天兆落地、佛运崩塌，早已瞒不过灵山顶层诸佛。
如来眸光沉扫全场，声震宝殿，强压动荡人心：“不过天道虚警、灵宝余孽作祟！尔等身为佛子，当静心固道、诵经镇劫，何以人人惶怯、自乱根基？”
话音落，殿中无人应声，唯有风声穿殿、肃穆萧瑟。
片刻，文殊菩萨踏步出列，双手合十，语气直言不讳，再无半分先前谄媚恭贺之态：“佛祖，虚警不会覆尽灵山瑞气，余孽不会撼动万古佛运！此次天兆绝非寻常警示，乃是天道定罚、因果落地！”
普贤紧随而出，神色凝重，高声补言：“我灵山此战，赢在诡计、输在天道！四神承玉盘天命、受苍生道印、得三界公示，名正言顺、道根清正。我等趁其重伤力竭、设局围杀、夺宝囚人、狱底酷刑，是以强逆道、以私伐公！今日黑云覆山、圣境崩塌，是天不佑佛！”
两句直言，戳破灵山所有虚妄遮羞布。
殿中小辈罗汉、诸天尊者瞬间骚动，低声议论四起，人心彻底溃散。
“原来真是我佛逆道！”
“难怪玉盘宁死反噬、绝不归宗！”
“天命不可逆，因果不可消，我们夺了不该夺的机缘，揽了万古大祸！”
如来金眸骤沉，威压轰然炸开，金色禅气席卷整座宝殿，震得殿梁微颤：“放肆！劫数博弈、机缘取舍，本就是强者之道！四神德不配宝、力守不住，我灵山接手镇劫，乃是安定三界、平定乱象！何来逆道之说？尔等妖言惑心、动摇佛基，该当何罪！”
强横佛压当头镇压，下位诸佛尽数垂首屏息，不敢再多言语。
可顶层四大古佛，个个道行万古、洞悉天机，早已看透始末，此刻再无盲从之心。
燃灯古佛缓步出列，手持万劫灯盏，灯火黯淡飘摇，声线沧桑冷肃：“佛祖不必强压人心，更不必自欺欺人。老朽历万载仙佛劫争，见尽天道轮回、成败因果。顺道者昌，逆道者亡，从未有变！
若是夺盘归佛为正道，何以佛运骤衰？

若是囚压四神为定乱，何以天罚降临？
若是我佛执掌公道，何以圣境崩裂、金莲枯死、禅气溃烂？
事实在前，抵不得半分强权诡辩！今日灵山之祸，不是外道作祟，是佛门自作自受！”
一语落，满堂死寂！
燃灯辈分至高、道果至深，乃是灵山第一古佛，他的定论，等同于敲碎佛门万古正义假面！
东方不动尊佛面色铁青，踏步上前，声含怒意：“当初布局，佛祖力主速战、强夺玉盘、囚杀四神！我等本劝循序渐进、不可逆天过甚，可佛祖执意强行收官、趁伤围猎！如今大祸临头、天罚压顶，谁来担此万古业债？”
南方宝生佛亦面露沉悔，冷声道：“此战赢得荒唐、败得彻底！看似夺得至宝、执掌浩劫，实则揽尽苍生怨气、背下逆天重罪！如今进退无路，驯盘则天罚加剧，放盘则霸业崩塌，囚神则祸根难消，杀神则万劫不复！我灵山已然走入绝路！”
两大古佛公然问责、直言对峙！
灵山高层，彻底分裂！
不空成就佛眉头紧锁，出声制衡：“事已至此，追责无用！当下最紧要者，是稳住佛心、共抗天罚！内讧猜忌、相互推诿，只会加速灵山覆灭！”
“稳住？”不动尊佛冷笑回头，气场对冲，“局面如何稳？天道反噬不休、玉盘日日抗拒、大地佛纹崩裂、佛运寸寸衰败！再稳下去，便是整座灵山覆灭、万佛业力焚身！”
“那依你之见？放弃玉盘、释放四神，拱手将天机还予外道？”不空成就佛声线转厉，佛气轰然对冲。
两股古佛威压在殿中轰然碰撞！
无声气浪炸开，殿内金砖震颤、佛旗翻卷、经册纷飞！
两大古佛当场气场对峙、暗斗交锋！
诸佛骇然后退，人人心惊！
万古灵山，从未有四大古佛当众分裂、气场相争的乱象！
文殊见状急喝：“二位古佛息怒！大敌当前，不可自损战力！”
content_en:
The tops of Lingshan Mountain are covered with black clouds.
Since the jade plate backfired and the ominous omen descended from the sky, in just half a day, the once peaceful Buddhist holy land had completely turned into a catastrophic purgatory.
The sea of ​​clouds for thousands of miles has all darkened, the golden light and mist have dissipated inch by inch, and the golden lotus all over the mountain has withered, blackened, broken, and scattered in the wind. The thousand-year-old Dharma-protecting spiritual lamp trembles in light and darkness, the fire flickers and is about to go out, the Zen trees in the mountains have lost their spiritual energy, and their branches are withered and rustling with dust. The Buddha pattern on the earth is cracked faintly, and the fine black lines spread across the peaks and mountains, like rotten wood collapsing and rotting, like karma fire eating its roots.
Within the Leiyin Palace, there was an oppressive silence, and murderous intent was undercurrent.
The hustle and bustle of the previous celebration ceremony was gone. All the Buddhas in the hall stood in two rows, with solemn expressions and panic. There was fear, suspicion and regret hidden in their eyes. On the ninth lotus platform, the Tathagata's golden body sits upright, and the Buddha's light on the surface is dim and floating, no longer as glorious as before.
Previously, he forcibly activated the origin of the Ten Thousand Buddhas to tame the jade plate, but it was counterattacked by the heavenly Dao of the common people. The Buddhist power was disordered, the Dao foundation was shaken, and the internal organs were injured. However, he suppressed it forcefully and kept it secret. But when the heavenly sign fell to the ground and the Buddha's destiny collapsed, it could no longer be hidden from the Buddhas at the top of Lingshan Mountain.
The Tathagata's eyes swept across the whole place, his voice shook the palace, and the people's hearts were shaken with force: "But the way of heaven is a false alarm, and the remnants of the spiritual treasures are causing trouble! As disciples of the Buddha, you should meditate to consolidate the path, chant sutras and suppress calamities. Why are everyone so scared and disturbing their foundations?"
After the words fell, no one in the hall responded, only the sound of wind penetrated the hall, solemn and desolate.
After a moment, Manjusri Bodhisattva stepped out of the queue, clasped his hands, and spoke in a straightforward tone, without even a hint of the flattery and congratulations he had previously shown: "Buddha, false alarms will not wipe out the auspiciousness of Lingshan Mountain, and the remaining evil will not shake the destiny of Buddhas throughout the ages! This heavenly sign is by no means an ordinary warning, but a punishment determined by heaven, and cause and effect!"
Samantabhadra came out immediately, with a solemn look on his face, and added in a loud voice: "In this battle at Lingshan, we won by trickery and lost by the way of heaven! The four gods inherited the destiny of the jade plate, received the seal of the common people, and were declared in the three realms. Their names are justified and their roots are pure. We took advantage of his serious injuries and exhausted his strength to set up a trap to kill, seize treasures and imprison people, and tortured in prison. We used force to rebel against the law and privately attack the public! Today, black clouds cover the mountain and the holy realm collapses. God does not bless the Buddha!"
Two blunt sentences expose all the false fig leaves in Lingshan.
The junior arhats and the venerable gods in the hall instantly became commotion, whispering and whispering, and their hearts were completely shattered.
"It turns out that I, the Buddha, am really contrary to the Tao!"
"No wonder Yupan would rather die than return to the clan!"
"Destiny is irreversible, and cause and effect cannot be undone. We took the opportunity that we shouldn't have taken away, and brought about an eternal disaster!"
The Tathagata's golden eyes suddenly sank, and the pressure suddenly exploded. The golden Zen energy swept through the entire palace, shaking the palace beams slightly: "Unbridled! The game of calamity and chance selection is the way of the strong! The four divine virtues are not worthy of treasures and cannot be defended. I, Lingshan, took over to suppress the calamity, in order to stabilize the three realms and calm the chaos! Where are the words that go against the path? You are deceiving the mind and shaking the Buddha's foundation with your monstrous words. What kind of crime should you do!"
The tyrannical Buddha suppressed him head-on. All the lower Buddhas lowered their heads and held their breath, not daring to say any more words.
But the four ancient Buddhas on the top floor have all practiced the Way for eternity and have insight into the secrets of heaven. They have already seen through the beginning and end, and now they no longer have the intention to blindly follow them.
The ancient Buddha of Burning Deng walked slowly out of the queue, holding a lamp of ten thousand kalpas, the light was dim and swaying, and his voice was cold and solemn after vicissitudes of life: "Buddha does not need to force people's hearts, let alone deceive themselves and others. The immortals and Buddhas have been fighting for thousands of years, and they have seen the reincarnation of heaven and the cause and effect of success and failure. Those who follow the way prosper, and those who go against the way perish, this has never changed!
If seizing the disk and returning to the Buddha is the right path, why does the Buddha's destiny suddenly decline?
If the four gods were imprisoned and suppressed in order to quell chaos, why would heaven's punishment come?
If I, the Buddha, were in charge of justice, why would the holy realm collapse, the golden lotus die, and the Zen energy fester?
Facts come first and are not worth the sophistry of power! Today's disaster in Lingshan is not caused by heretics, but by Buddhism itself! "
As soon as the words fell, the whole hall fell silent!
Ran Deng has the highest seniority and profound Taoist achievements, and is the first ancient Buddha in Lingshan. His conclusion is equivalent to shattering the eternal mask of justice in Buddhism!
Dongfang Fudo Buddha's face was livid, he stepped forward and said with anger in his voice: "In the original layout, the Buddha advocated quick battle and robbery.Jade plate, imprison and kill the four gods! We originally advised you to proceed step by step and never go too far, but Buddha insisted on ending things by force and taking advantage of the situation to hunt! Now that disaster is imminent and heaven's punishment is overwhelming, who will shoulder this eternal karmic debt? "
Nanfang Baosheng Buddha also showed deep regret on his face and said coldly: "We won this battle ridiculously and lost completely! It seems that he has obtained the treasure and is responsible for the catastrophe, but in fact he has taken over all the grievances of the people and committed a heinous crime! Now there is no way to advance or retreat. If you tame the god, the punishment from heaven will be intensified, if you let go, the hegemony will collapse, if you imprison the god, the root of the disaster will be difficult to eliminate, and if you kill the god, the disaster will be irreversible! My Lingshan has reached a dead end! "
The two ancient Buddhas are openly accountable and confront each other!
The top management of Lingshan was completely divided!
Buddha Buddha Fukong frowned and said in a counter-balanced voice: "The matter has come to this, there is no point in pursuing blame! The most important thing at the moment is to stabilize the Buddha's heart and resist heaven's punishment together! Internal strife, suspicion, and mutual blame will only accelerate the destruction of Lingshan! "
"Steady? Fudo Buddha sneered and turned around, his aura counteracting, "How can the situation be stable?" Heaven's way keeps backlashing, the jade plate resists day by day, the Buddha patterns on the earth crumble, and the Buddha's luck declines every inch! If it continues to be stable, the entire spiritual mountain will be destroyed and the karma of ten thousand Buddhas will be burned! "
"What do you think? Give up the jade plate, release the four gods, and return the secret of heaven to the heretics? "The voice of Fu Kongcheng Buddha became louder, and the Buddha's aura suddenly clashed.
The two ancient Buddhas collided with each other in the hall!
A silent air wave exploded, the golden bricks in the hall trembled, the Buddhist flags rolled, and the scriptures flew!
The two ancient Buddhas confronted each other and had a secret fight on the spot!
The Buddhas were horrified and retreated, and everyone was frightened!
In Eternal Spiritual Mountain, there has never been a chaos in which the four ancient Buddhas split in public and had their auras competing!
Seeing this, Manjusri shouted hurriedly: "Two ancient Buddhas, please calm down! In the face of a powerful enemy, you must not compromise your combat power! "
